verses.original: לְדָוִ֨ד׀ בָּרֲכִ֣י יְהוָ֑ה נַ֭פְשִׁי אֶת־ וְכָל־ קְ֝רָבַ֗י אֶת־ קָדְשֽׁוֹ׃ שֵׁ֥ם
verses.transliteration: lə·ḏā·wiḏ bā·ră·ḵî Yah·weh nap̄·šî ’eṯ- wə·ḵāl qə·rā·ḇay ’eṯ- qā·ḏə·šōw šêm
verses.literal: Of David Bless the LORD O my soul - all that is within me - [bless] His holy name

verses.original: בָּרֲכִ֣י יְהוָ֑ה נַ֭פְשִׁי אֶת־ וְאַל־ תִּ֝שְׁכְּחִ֗י כָּל־ גְּמוּלָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: bā·ră·ḵî Yah·weh nap̄·šî ’eṯ- wə·’al- tiš·kə·ḥî kāl- gə·mū·lāw
verses.literal: Bless the LORD O my soul - and do not forget all His kind deeds

verses.original: הַסֹּלֵ֥חַ לְכָל־ עֲוֺנֵ֑כִי הָ֝רֹפֵ֗א לְכָל־ תַּחֲלֻאָֽיְכִי׃
verses.transliteration: has·sō·lê·aḥ lə·ḵāl ‘ă·wō·nê·ḵî hā·rō·p̄ê lə·ḵāl ta·ḥă·lu·’ā·yə·ḵî
verses.literal: He who forgives all your iniquities and heals all your diseases

verses.original: הַגּוֹאֵ֣ל חַיָּ֑יְכִי מִשַּׁ֣חַת הַֽ֝מְעַטְּרֵ֗כִי חֶ֣סֶד וְרַחֲמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: hag·gō·w·’êl ḥay·yā·yə·ḵî miš·ša·ḥaṯ ham·‘aṭ·ṭə·rê·ḵî ḥe·seḏ wə·ra·ḥă·mîm
verses.literal: who redeems your life from the Pit [and] crowns you with loving devotion and compassion

verses.original: הַמַּשְׂבִּ֣יַע בַּטּ֣וֹב עֶדְיֵ֑ךְ נְעוּרָֽיְכִי׃ תִּתְחַדֵּ֖שׁ כַּנֶּ֣שֶׁר
verses.transliteration: ham·maś·bi·ya‘ baṭ·ṭō·wḇ ‘eḏ·yêḵ nə·‘ū·rā·yə·ḵî tiṯ·ḥad·dêš kan·ne·šer
verses.literal: who satisfies you with good things so that your youth is renewed like the eagle’s

verses.original: יְהוָ֑ה עֹשֵׂ֣ה צְדָק֣וֹת וּ֝מִשְׁפָּטִ֗ים לְכָל־ עֲשׁוּקִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ‘ō·śêh ṣə·ḏā·qō·wṯ ū·miš·pā·ṭîm lə·ḵāl ‘ă·šū·qîm
verses.literal: The LORD executes righteousness and justice for all the oppressed

verses.original: יוֹדִ֣יעַ דְּרָכָ֣יו לְמֹשֶׁ֑ה עֲלִילֽוֹתָיו׃ לִבְנֵ֥י יִ֝שְׂרָאֵ֗ל
verses.transliteration: yō·w·ḏî·a‘ də·rā·ḵāw lə·mō·šeh ‘ă·lî·lō·w·ṯāw liḇ·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: He made known His ways to Moses His deeds to the people of Israel

verses.original: יְהוָ֑ה רַח֣וּם וְחַנּ֣וּן אֶ֖רֶךְ אַפַּ֣יִם וְרַב־ חָֽסֶד׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ra·ḥūm wə·ḥan·nūn ’e·reḵ ’ap·pa·yim wə·raḇ- ḥā·seḏ
verses.literal: The LORD is compassionate and gracious slow to anger abounding in loving devotion

verses.original: לֹֽא־ לָנֶ֥צַח יָרִ֑יב וְלֹ֖א יִטּֽוֹר׃ לְעוֹלָ֣ם
verses.transliteration: lō- lā·ne·ṣaḥ yā·rîḇ wə·lō yiṭ·ṭō·wr lə·‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: He will not always accuse us nor harbor [His anger] forever

verses.original: לֹ֣א עָ֣שָׂה וְלֹ֥א לָ֑נוּ כַ֭חֲטָאֵינוּ גָּמַ֥ל עָלֵֽינוּ׃ כַ֝עֲוֺנֹתֵ֗ינוּ
verses.transliteration: lō ‘ā·śāh wə·lō lā·nū ḵa·ḥă·ṭā·’ê·nū gā·mal ‘ā·lê·nū ḵa·‘ă·wō·nō·ṯê·nū
verses.literal: He has not dealt with us according to our sins or repaid us according to our iniquities

verses.original: כִּ֤י כִגְבֹ֣הַּ שָׁ֭מַיִם עַל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ גָּבַ֥ר חַ֝סְדּ֗וֹ עַל־ יְרֵאָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḵiḡ·ḇō·ah šā·ma·yim ‘al- hā·’ā·reṣ gā·ḇar ḥas·dōw ‘al- yə·rê·’āw
verses.literal: For as high as the heavens are above the earth so great is His loving devotion for those who fear Him

verses.original: כִּרְחֹ֣ק מִ֭זְרָח מִ֝מֶּ֗נּוּ אֶת־ מִֽמַּֽעֲרָ֑ב הִֽרְחִ֥יק פְּשָׁעֵֽינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kir·ḥōq miz·rāḥ mim·men·nū ’eṯ- mim·ma·‘ă·rāḇ hir·ḥîq pə·šā·‘ê·nū
verses.literal: As far as the east is from - the west so far has He removed our transgressions from us

verses.original: אָ֭ב כְּרַחֵ֣ם עַל־ בָּנִ֑ים יְ֝הוָ֗ה רִחַ֥ם עַל־ יְרֵאָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: ’āḇ kə·ra·ḥêm ‘al- bā·nîm Yah·weh ri·ḥam ‘al- yə·rê·’āw
verses.literal: As a father has compassion on his children so the LORD has compassion on those who fear Him

verses.original: כִּי־ ה֖וּא יָדַ֣ע יִצְרֵ֑נוּ זָ֝כ֗וּר כִּי־ אֲנָֽחְנוּ׃ עָפָ֥ר
verses.transliteration: kî- hū yā·ḏa‘ yiṣ·rê·nū zā·ḵūr kî- ’ă·nā·ḥə·nū ‘ā·p̄ār
verses.literal: For He knows our frame He is mindful that we are dust

verses.original: אֱ֭נוֹשׁ יָמָ֑יו כֶּחָצִ֣יר יָצִֽיץ׃ כְּצִ֥יץ הַ֝שָּׂדֶ֗ה כֵּ֣ן
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·nō·wōš yā·māw ke·ḥā·ṣîr yā·ṣîṣ kə·ṣîṣ haś·śā·ḏeh kên
verses.literal: As for man his days are like grass he blooms like a flower of the field . . .

verses.original: כִּ֤י ר֣וּחַ עָֽבְרָה־ בּ֣וֹ וְאֵינֶ֑נּוּ מְקוֹמֽוֹ׃ יַכִּירֶ֖נּוּ וְלֹא־ ע֣וֹד
verses.transliteration: kî rū·aḥ ‘ā·ḇə·rāh- bōw wə·’ê·nen·nū mə·qō·w·mōw yak·kî·ren·nū wə·lō- ‘ō·wḏ
verses.literal: when the wind passes over it vanishes and its place remembers it no more

verses.original: מֵעוֹלָ֣ם וְעַד־ ע֭וֹלָם וְחֶ֤סֶד יְהוָ֨ה׀ עַל־ יְרֵאָ֑יו וְ֝צִדְקָת֗וֹ לִבְנֵ֥י בָנִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: mê·‘ō·w·lām wə·‘aḏ- ‘ō·w·lām wə·ḥe·seḏ Yah·weh ‘al- yə·rê·’āw wə·ṣiḏ·qā·ṯōw liḇ·nê ḇā·nîm
verses.literal: But from everlasting to everlasting the loving devotion of the LORD extends to those who fear Him and His righteousness to their children’s children

verses.original: לְשֹׁמְרֵ֥י בְרִית֑וֹ וּלְזֹכְרֵ֥י לַעֲשׂוֹתָֽם׃ פִ֝קֻּדָ֗יו
verses.transliteration: lə·šō·mə·rê ḇə·rî·ṯōw ū·lə·zō·ḵə·rê la·‘ă·śō·w·ṯām p̄iq·qu·ḏāw
verses.literal: to those who keep His covenant and remember to obey His precepts

verses.original: יְֽהוָ֗ה הֵכִ֣ין כִּסְא֑וֹ בַּ֭שָּׁמַיִם וּ֝מַלְכוּת֗וֹ מָשָֽׁלָה׃ בַּכֹּ֥ל
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh hê·ḵîn kis·’ōw baš·šā·ma·yim ū·mal·ḵū·ṯōw mā·šā·lāh bak·kōl
verses.literal: The LORD has established His throne in heaven and His kingdom rules over all

verses.original: בָּרֲכ֥וּ יְהוָ֗ה מַלְאָ֫כָ֥יו גִּבֹּ֣רֵי כֹ֭חַ עֹשֵׂ֣י דְבָר֑וֹ לִ֝שְׁמֹ֗עַ בְּק֣וֹל דְּבָרֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: bā·ră·ḵū Yah·weh mal·’ā·ḵāw gib·bō·rê ḵō·aḥ ‘ō·śê ḏə·ḇā·rōw liš·mō·a‘ bə·qō·wl də·ḇā·rōw
verses.literal: Bless the LORD all His angels mighty in strength who carry out His word who hearken to the voice of His command

verses.original: בָּרֲכ֣וּ יְ֭הוָה כָּל־ צְבָאָ֑יו מְ֝שָׁרְתָ֗יו עֹשֵׂ֥י רְצוֹנֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: bā·ră·ḵū Yah·weh kāl- ṣə·ḇā·’āw mə·šā·rə·ṯāw ‘ō·śê rə·ṣō·w·nōw
verses.literal: Bless the LORD all His hosts you servants who do His will

verses.original: בָּרֲכ֤וּ יְהוָ֨ה׀ כָּֽל־ מַעֲשָׂ֗יו בְּכָל־ מְקֹמ֥וֹת מֶמְשַׁלְתּ֑וֹ בָּרֲכִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃ נַ֝פְשִׁ֗י אֶת־
verses.transliteration: bā·ră·ḵū Yah·weh kāl- ma·‘ă·śāw bə·ḵāl mə·qō·mō·wṯ mem·šal·tōw bā·ră·ḵî Yah·weh nap̄·šî ’eṯ-
verses.literal: Bless the LORD all His works in all places of His dominion Bless the LORD O my soul -
